Class Wizard

java.lang.Object
model.entity.base.CharacterModel
model.entity.base.PlayerCharacter
model.entity.concrete.Wizard
public class Wizard extends PlayerCharacter
Represents a Wizard-type playable character.

Wizards specialize in magic attacks and rely on agility and spell power. This class extends PlayerCharacter and supports the ability to use a PowerfulPotion, which temporarily enhances their abilities.

  • Method Details

    • usePowerfulPotion

      public void usePowerfulPotion(PowerfulPotion potion)
      Uses a PowerfulPotion on the Wizard. If a potion is already active, its effects are first removed. Then the new potion is applied by calling PowerfulPotion.use(PlayerCharacter).
      Parameters:
      potion - the potion the Wizard wants to use.

    • unusePowerfulPotion

      public void unusePowerfulPotion(PowerfulPotion potion)
      Removes the effects of the specified PowerfulPotion from the Wizard. The potion is removed only if it is the currently active one. No action is taken otherwise.
      Parameters:
      potion - the potion to deactivate.

    • getEquippedPowerfulPotion
